example_prompts: Define MQL and SQL stages, handoff SLAs and rejection reasons for our B2B SaaS. We get about 300 inbound leads a month and have 3 SDRs, 4 AEs and HubSpot.
Build me a lead scoring model with point values and an MQL threshold for a sales-led SaaS with a $15k average contract.
Leads sit for days before sales calls them. Redesign our routing and response-time rules: 2 SDRs, 3 AEs, demo requests plus a free trial.
Create a discount approval matrix and deal desk rules for our sales team. Typical deals are $20k a year and reps discount freely today.
